# S303 — Local model: classify an unreachable endpoint and fall back to the next row

*Proposed:* when a `-local` launcher cannot reach the server, ork moves to the next matrix row (adj 156) instead of pausing. This is the part of S301 that needs a measured sample (adj 23, 77).

**Findings:** S301 · **Size:** S · **Trees:** daemon, agent

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

- The Claude classifier returns unclassified for every non-success exit (`internal/agent/claude/classify.go:19-33`), and an unclassified exit stops for the owner (`internal/engine/ledger.go:45-46`). An unreachable local server would pause the run.
- No sample of an unreachable endpoint exists in `testdata/vendors/*`.
